source:
@@U03417@@
Disgusting sight! Hideous!

@@U03419@@
Serves you right! It’s what you deserve!

@@U03421@@
That clever little number is one I'd like to snatch— but as soon as | grab, a lizard slithers from my hand, her braid slick as a snake! Ah! Then that one there, tall and slender! And what do I have but a bacchic wand with a pinecone at its tip! Where does this end? Aha, this fat one, then, for a bit of a revel, but this the last! Here goes! Ah, all squishy-squiggly! Orientals, I’ve heard, pay in gold for this! Oh, but the puffball bursts in two! Phew!

@@U03423@@
Separate! Flit round him, this son of a witch! Like lightning, like darkness, swaying, hovering, black bat wings pounding in fearsome circles! Let him not get off so lightly!
translation:
@@U03417@@
恶心的景象！可怕！

@@U03419@@
为您服务就对了！这是你应得的！

@@U03421@@
那个聪明的小数字是我想抢走的——但是一旦|抓住，一只蜥蜴从我手中滑落，她的辫子像蛇一样光滑！啊!然后就是那个，又高又瘦！我除了一根顶端有松果的酒鬼魔杖之外还有什么！这到哪里结束呢？啊哈，这个胖子，然后，为了一点狂欢，但这是最后一次！开始吧！啊，全都是软软的！我听说东方人为此支付黄金！哦，但是马勃裂成了两半！唷！

@@U03423@@
分开！在他身边飞来飞去，这个女巫之子！如闪电，如黑暗，摇曳，盘旋，黑色的蝙蝠翅膀拍打着可怕的圆圈！让他不要这么轻易下车！
